definitions.cagr: Whole January 1 2024 through endpoint only. Exact elapsed milliseconds / 86400000 / 365.25. 1004 September daily rows and 1023 October daily rows; no 19-day annualization.
definitions.nav: Same r20 daily mark-price equity; standalone endpoint replaces last mark NAV with fee-adjusted spot/perp liquidation cash. Total capital 5000; venue capital 2500 differs only by external idle cash.
definitions.october_increment: Difference of two separately computed single-exit endpoint valuations = October funding + basis-price change - change in exit fees. September exit never charged to continuation.
definitions.monthly: All fixed 33 complete calendar months retained. September standalone includes September hypothetical exit; continuation does not. October partial kept separately, excluded from 33-month correlation.
definitions.benchmark: Exactly r20 prior-close > prior-200-closes BTC SMA gross reference, including 2023 warmup. Not a costed executable strategy.
limits: No invented numerical low-correlation cutoff or pass; GUIDE low correlation remains descriptive.
